long_biography.plain_text:
Hall's apartment holdings expanded nationally before the savings-and-loan downturn forced a major restructuring. He moved away from apartments toward independently owned commercial development and launched HALL Structured Finance as a national real-estate lender. The recovery changed both the mix of his businesses and the way he approached ownership through later economic cycles.

Today, Hall serves as chairman and chief executive of the privately held enterprise that he and his family own. Its work spans property development, structured finance, startup investment and wine. HALL Park, HALL Arts and the lending portfolio belong to group entities, not to Hall personally. He and Kathryn are co-proprietors of several wine brands, but her legal and diplomatic career—including service as U.S. ambassador to Austria—is her own record.
